journey.title: Configure the same install from a terminal
journey.purpose: The declarative surface reaches the same result as the browser, which is what makes remote and automated onboarding possible.

steps.intent: Establish the reference selection in the browser and export it.

claims.statement: Applying the exported selection through the non-interactive CLI on a clean host produces byte-identical operator state.
claims.rationale: The browser half is recorded here; the CLI half is asserted by the parity integration test. Neither alone proves the claim.

claims.statement: The readiness command exits non-zero when a required item is not ready, so automation can gate on it.
